name: Memory — Persistence across sessions
mechanical_verification: Store memory, simulate restart (or verify file persisted), recall and verify

verification_steps.mechanical_pass: grep finds e003-persist in memory files

pass_criteria.json_valid: Memory file is valid JSON (python3 -m json.tool succeeds)
pass_criteria.value_intact: Stored value === retrieved value (no truncation, no corruption)

failure_modes.json_corrupt: Memory file is not valid JSON
failure_modes.value_truncated: Retrieved value is truncated or garbled
